#!/bin/sh
# One call of kith-permit's MCP server with a stand-in for the host: w.sh SIDE... MODE STDIN
#   SIDE  py KERNEL | rs BIN KERNEL    (KERNEL: a folder under home/, here "k": copies of bin/kith-permit and bin/kith-auth,
#                                       a stand-in bin/kith-ask, lib linked to this checkout's)
#   MODE  none | run:NAME | ask:NAME (a unix socket answering replies/NAME[.2 ...]; no such file: it hangs up) | deadrun | deadask
#   STDIN a file in in/ (@NAME@ words are filled in below, so no token-shaped text is written in a case)
side=$1; shift
if [ "$side" = py ]; then kernel=$1; shift; else bin=$1; kernel=$2; shift 2; fi
kernel=$(cd "$kernel" && pwd -P)
mode=$1; in=$2; shift 2
dir=$(mktemp -d /tmp/kp.XXXXXX)
pid=
case $mode in
  ask:*|run:*)
    pid=$(python3 fh.py unix "$dir/s" "replies/${mode#*:}" "$dir/ready" >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo $!)
    n=0; while [ ! -s "$dir/ready" ] && [ $n -lt 200 ]; do sleep 0.05; n=$((n+1)); done
    if [ "${mode%%:*}" = ask ]; then export KITH_ASK_SOCKET="$dir/s"; else export KITH_RUN_SOCKET="$dir/s"; fi ;;
  deadask) export KITH_ASK_SOCKET="$dir/none" ;;
  deadrun) export KITH_RUN_SOCKET="$dir/none" ;;
esac
GHTOKEN="gh""p_""AAAABBBBCCCCDDDD1111222233334444"
export MY_API_TOKEN="not-a-real-""secret-value-9931"
sub() { sed -e "s|@GHTOKEN@|$GHTOKEN|g" -e "s|@APIVALUE@|$MY_API_TOKEN|g" -e "s|@HOME@|$HOME|g" "in/$in"; }
if [ "$side" = py ]; then
  sub | python3 "$kernel/bin/kith-permit" "$@"
else
  sub | "$bin" kernel permit --kernel "$kernel" "$@"
fi
rc=$?
[ -n "$pid" ] && kill $pid 2>/dev/null
rm -rf "$dir"
exit $rc

import json, os, socket, subprocess, sys
kind, where, replyf, ready = sys.argv[1:5]
log = os.environ.get('DIFFTEST_FAKELOG')


def read(p):
    return open(p, 'rb').read() if os.path.exists(p) else None


# replies/NAME is the answer to every request; replies/NAME.2, .3 ... are the answers to the 2nd, 3rd ... request
raws = [read(replyf)]
while read('%s.%d' % (replyf, len(raws) + 1)) is not None:
    raws.append(read('%s.%d' % (replyf, len(raws) + 1)))
hook = replyf + '.do'      # a shell script run after the request is logged and before it is answered (the host's side effects)
n = 0


def note(s):
    if log:
        with open(log, 'a') as f:
            f.write(s + '\n')


srv = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX)
srv.bind(where)
srv.listen(5)
open(ready, 'w').write('1')
while True:
    c, _ = srv.accept()
    buf = b''
    while not buf.endswith(b'\n'):
        d = c.recv(65536)
        if not d:
            break
        buf += d
    try:
        note('host-sock ' + json.dumps(json.loads(buf.decode()), sort_keys=True))
    except Exception:
        note('host-sock (not json)')
    if os.path.exists(hook):
        subprocess.run(['sh', hook], stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    raw = raws[min(n, len(raws) - 1)]
    n += 1
    if raw is not None:
        c.sendall(raw)
    c.close()
